def rects(grid,min_h=5,min_w=5):
 R,C=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[]
 # all rectangles with uniform color via maintaining common columns across rows
 for top in range(R):
  for color in set(grid[top]):
   good=[grid[top][c]==color for c in range(C)]
   for bot in range(top,R):
    if bot>top: good=[good[c] and grid[bot][c]==color for c in range(C)]
    h=bot-top+1
    if h<min_h: continue
    c=0
    while c<C:
     if not good[c]: c+=1; continue
     s=c
     while c<C and good[c]: c+=1
     if c-s>=min_w: out.append((top,bot,s,c-1,color))
 return out
